review_text:
Independent HEADER mathematics review for prospective next71
Reviewer: /root/anonymous_decoder70, acting in the newly assigned header-math role.
Verdict: PASS_HEADER_MATH_ONLY. No mathematical obstruction or omitted hypothesis was found in the proposed added identity. This is not a Lean proof, source-fidelity verdict, SAU claim, or completion claim.

Permitted inputs and interface comparison
Only the proposed literal header, its proposal JSON, and the specified parent ActualProjectedRotation.lean were read. The parent is described as compiled in the assignment; it was not recompiled here. Source-identifying comments and proposal status metadata are visible in these permitted files but were not used as evidence for a source or mathematical verdict. No Primary71 review, external source, other packet, earlier reconstruction, Git state or canonical metadata was consumed. The previously closed decoder70 directory was untouched.

The entire private literal was extracted from its first caller binder through its closing parenthesis, excluding only the private definition name and the following public theorem. A direct RAW-byte comparison finds a 7,078-byte common prefix and 3-byte common closing suffix. The parent has no intervening bytes; the proposal inserts exactly 233 UTF8 bytes: conjunction, the local definition of C, and its asserted change formula. Deleting precisely those bytes recovers the entire old literal including caller binders. In particular every old clause, quantifier scope, actual output definition, old pair-energy identity, and existing conclusion is preserved byte for byte.

All twelve common existential witnesses are unchanged, in the same order and same scopes: S, e, U, T, Gamma, q, GammaP0, Inv, A0, B0, V0, R. The full common-witness prefix is bytewise identical. The private-definition caller binders and both public theorem caller-binder lists are bytewise identical. The six named proof callers remain h_alpha, h_alphabeta, h_V, h_H, h_eta, h_betaeta. No caller, common witness, regularity condition, nontriviality assumption, rank restriction or strict step-size condition has been added. Import, namespace, declaration identity and the public return-type definition name change to name the proposed extension; these wrapper names are outside the compared literal and do not change its mathematical premises.

The added C is a local function definition inside the existing per-centered-input output conclusion, not a new premise or existential common witness. Its exact mathematical value is
  C(u,v) = (||u||^2-||v||^2)/2 - <A0(Inv u),v>.
It uses the SAME already produced A0 and Inv on the SAME centered Hilbert space HP0. The formula is asserted for the already produced actual output components gP and gV. They remain identified respectively by conditional expectation of g and by V0^*(R g), where g=U(P f-(f-P f)); they are not redefined by the desired formula. The input still ranges over every joint f with zero joint mean, with mean zero of its actual output concluded internally as before.

Mathematical derivation without extra hypotheses
Work in the real Hilbert space HP0, which need not be finite-dimensional. Abbreviate A=A0, G=GammaP0, Iinv=Inv, Q=A Iinv. The old clauses give selfadjoint A and Iinv, positive hence selfadjoint G, commuting A with G and Iinv, A^2+G^2=identity, and the SAME two-sided inverse Iinv G=G Iinv=identity. Thus Q is selfadjoint, commutes with A and G, and QG=GQ=A. These properties are consequences of retained old clauses, not extra caller hypotheses.

For arbitrary u,v in HP0 put u'=Au-Gv and v'=Gu+Av. Define k=<Au,Gv>. Selfadjointness, commutation and real-inner-product symmetry give
  k=<Gu,Av>=<Q G^2 u,v>.
The square identity gives ||Aw||^2+||Gw||^2=||w||^2 for every w. Expanding real Hilbert norms yields
  (||u'||^2-||v'||^2)/2
    = (||Au||^2-||Gu||^2+||Gv||^2-||Av||^2)/2 - 2k.
Expanding the cross term, using QG=A and moving the selfadjoint factors through the inner product, gives
  <Q u',v'>
    = ||Au||^2-||Av||^2 + <Q A^2 u,v> - k.
Subtract the second equality from the first, use k=<Q G^2 u,v> and A^2+G^2=identity, and obtain
  C(u',v') = -||u||^2/2 + ||v||^2/2 - <Q u,v>.
Since C(u,v)=||u||^2/2-||v||^2/2-<Q u,v>, subtraction gives exactly
  C(u',v')-C(u,v) = -||u||^2+||v||^2.
Substitute the retained actual rotation identities
  gP=A0 fP-GammaP0 fV,
  gV=GammaP0 fP+A0 fV,
to obtain the proposed formula for C(gP,gV)-C(fP,fV), with precisely its displayed sign and coefficient. No diagonalization, eigenbasis, finite-rank premise, new inverse, new spectral gap, additional source regularity or onto property of V0 is used.

An independent exact finite rational-symbolic check reaches the same result. In the commutative operator algebra generated by A and G with G inverted, represent the rotation by [[A,-G],[G,A]] and C by the selfadjoint quadratic-form matrix (1/2)[[identity,-A G^(-1)],[-A G^(-1),-identity]]. The exact residual rotation^* Cmatrix rotation-Cmatrix+diag(identity,-identity) reduces to the zero matrix using only A^2+G^2=identity and G G^(-1)=G^(-1)G=identity. This supplements the derivation; it is not a Lean compilation or proof implementation.

Permitted boundary cases
Rank zero is allowed. If HP0 is the zero Hilbert space, its sole endomorphism is also its identity, so the two-sided inverse equations and unit statement are meaningful; every vector and corrector value is zero and the new identity is 0=0. The caller interface also permits rank-zero E. Neither the algebra nor the added conclusion divides by a vector norm or assumes a nonzero vector.

The endpoint alpha*eta=1 is allowed because the old assumption is beta*eta<=1. Combined with alpha<=beta and eta>0 this is compatible and forces beta*eta=1. The old gamma=2 sqrt(alpha*eta)/(1+alpha*eta) is then 1, not zero, so Inv remains legitimate. For completeness, on HP0 the old positivity G>=identity and A^2+G^2=identity force G=identity and A=0: G is both expansive and contractive, and positivity fixes the sign. Inv=identity; the actual rotation is (u',v')=(-v,u), C(u,v)=(||u||^2-||v||^2)/2, and the required change is still exactly -||u||^2+||v||^2. This endpoint argument is explanatory; the general derivation already covers it without a strict inequality or division by 1-alpha*eta.

Review limits
No Lean implementation, elaboration, compilation, kernel check, theorem publication, source comparison or canonical edit was performed. The prospective header ends after an unfold step and is explicitly a proposal, so this review does not upgrade its proof status. All conclusions here concern mathematical validity and preservation of the existing interface only. Root remains the sole canonical writer. The review package is independently sealed and must not be rewritten after its final lease.
